name: duct-motion
description: Remotion compositions for the Duct launch film and the landing-page loops. Renders land in site/assets/media; nothing here ships to the site at runtime.

scripts.render:film: npm run sync-assets && remotion render Film out/demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 24 --audio-bitrate 96k && remotion render Film out/demo.webm --codec vp9 --crf 38 --audio-bitrate 80k && npm run -s poster
scripts.poster: remotion still Film out/demo-poster.png --frame 520 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/demo-poster.png -quality 80 out/demo-poster.webp
